units.name: SwapCameraXForStage4

units.name: Stage5WaveEffect
units.summary: Stage 5 only: computes scroll offsets from $B6/$B7, waits for sprite-0 hit and runs RasterWaveLoop for 31 lines to produce a per-scanline wave, then sets the final horizontal scroll.

units.name: Stage5RasterAndObjects
units.summary: Stage 5 only: run the wave effect and the object update during the NMI-driven frame, and swap $F6/$CF while unpaused.

units.name: WaitForNmiThenResume
units.summary: Main-thread yield: X/Y = low/high address of the continuation. Stores it in MainThreadResume, enables background+sprites in the mask shadow, clears the frame counters, then sets PpuCtrlShadow bit 7 and enables NMI. The CPU then idles in IdleStirRng until the NMI sees bit 7, resets the stack and jumps to the continuation.

units.name: AdvanceFrameCounters
units.summary: FrameCounter += 1; FrameCounterHalf += 1 every second frame.

units.name: EndFrameAndWait
units.summary: Common end of a main-thread frame: advance counters and re-arm the NMI resume.

units.name: IdleStirRng
units.summary: Idle loop of the main thread: keeps mixing the RNG until the NMI takes over.

units.name: StirRngState
units.summary: Mixes frame counters and player 1 position bytes into RngState.

units.name: NextRandom
units.summary: Advances RngState and returns a pseudo-random byte in A (also in $2C).

units.name: ObjType1C_Jumper

While Obj_0548 is set it runs the alternate held/linked path at $BA78. Tentative identity (jumping enemy); mechanics only.

units.name: SetDirFromBit1

editorial_audit.notes: Final strict editorial audit (2026-11-20, pass-005). Review credit from rounds 1-4 reused for unchanged regions/notes (no evidence changes outside the five L-027 bytes). Checks: 1661/1661 scaffold entries reviewed with source locations; every code region has reviewed units (49 unlabelled uncalled-fragment regions now carry their own Fragment_bN_$AAAA unit); 4,237 labels unique, no address-only routine names (L_Bn_ labels are local branch targets only, never jsr targets); every data region carries a format/consumer note or the evidence-derived consumer note; iNES header note added; overlong comment lines rewrapped (0 > 110 chars); no TODO/FIXME markers; stale unknown-byte notes replaced. Findings: the five L-027 bytes (b0 $8D92, b4 $B979, b5 $ACFA, b6 $9745, b6 $EFE5) are USER-DIRECTED MANUAL FALLBACK generic data of unknown meaning, not evidence-backed; their notes and commentary/uncertainties.md say so. Historical "Round N name" remarks are retained deliberately as rename provenance. Remaining semantic uncertainties are listed in commentary/uncertainties.md with mechanical descriptions.
